In the medial compartment, the medial meniscus; horizontal tear at the body through the posterior horn. Extruded into the medial gutter. Diffuse lowe grade chondrosis with osteophyte formation.  
  
 The lateral compartment, bone marrow edema at mid anterior tibial plateau and underneath tibial spine.  the lateral meniscus is not torn. Diffuse lowe grade chondrosis with osteophyte formation 
  
 The patellofemoral joint, bone marrow edema at lateral patellar and trochlear with diffuse high grade chondrosis, and osteophyte formation. Suspicious for bone fracture along lateral patellar. The medial patellofemoral ligament is intact.  
  
 In the intercondylar notch, 
 Synovial thickening at anterior part of intercondylar region.  
 ACL: low grade partial tear at mid substance.  
 PCL: low grade partial tear at mid substance. 
 There is no anterior tibial translation.  
  
 The medial collateral ligamentous complexes are intact. The posteromedial oblique ligament is intact.  
  
 The lateral collateral ligament complexes; low grade injury at origin. The popliteofibular ligament is intact. The meniscopopliteal fascicles are intact.  
  
 The extensor mechanism is normal.  
  
 Some amount of effusion with synovial thickening is present.  
 Fluid along popliteus tendon.  
 The surrounding musculature is normal.  Suspicious for bone fracture along lateral patellar; bone marrow edema at lateral patellar and trochlear

Zur MR-VU von 05/16 nochmals progrediente Stigmata der medial betonten Panonarthrose mit osteophytären Anbauten aller Gelenkpartner sowie insbesondere im medialen Kompartiment progredienter flächiger vollschichtiger Chondropathie mit korrespondierend geringem Knochenmarksödem in der medialen Femurkondyle sowie dem medialen Tibiaplateau. Ebenfalls progrediente Chondropathie mit höhergradig geminderten Knorpelbesatz und V. a. fokal vollschichtige Chondropathie der lateralen Femurkondyle (4/23). Ebenfalls höhergradig geminderter Knorpelbesatz der Trochlea mit teils flächiger vollschichtiger Chondropathie. Teils höhergradige fokale, chondrale Läsionen auch retropatellar (8/10). Chondrale Osteophyten an der medialen Patellarückseite. Komplexe Rissbildung des Innenmeniskus in der Pars intermedia sowie dem Hinterhorn mit nach paratibial disloziertem Lappenriss (4/23). Außenmeniskus ohne Anhalt für eine Rissbildung. VKB mukoid. HKB intakt. MCL und LCL intakt. Akzentuierte Gelenkflüssigkeit. Lobulierte, flüssigkeitsgefüllte Baker-Zyste mit einer CC-Ausdehnung von ca. 7,8 cm. Quadriceps- sowie Patellarsehne mit intakter Darstellung. Die miterfassten Weichteile in den vorliegenden Sequenzen mit unauffälliger Signalgebung.

MRI of left Knee with 
-Locator, SG PD FatSat, SG T2W FS, SG T1W, CO T2W FS, AX T2W FS


* Status of  lateral subluxation of patella
Laxity of medila patellar retinaculum with mild increased singnal intensity, R/O grade 2 injury.
* Massively increased joint effusion and extending to proximal tibiofibular joint with hypertrophy of the synovium, indicative of synovitis;  Prominent suprapatellar bursitis  ; suprapatellar and medial plicae.
* The patellar length/ patellar tendon length =0.65 (<0.8) in this study; suspicious of  high riding patella.
* Mild fat stranding along proximal portion of patellar tendon and infrapatellar fat plane, maybe due to inflammation or post arthrocentesiis change.
Increased signal intensity of articular cartilage at lateral facet, R/O grade 1 chondromalacia.
* Tiny subchondral cysts in tibial eminence
* Increased infiltration in the muscle of popliteus muscle and intermuscular infiltration(srs:[ID], Img:24; srs:6001, Img:26), R/O mild myositis 

Impression: 
1.  Synovitis of knee joint with massive joint effusion and suprapatellar bursitis, R/O post-trumatic arthritis or inflammatory arthritis or infection. Suggest correlation with clinical manifestation and lab data.
2. Status of lateral subluxation of patella, R/O grade 2 injury of medial patellar retinaculum.
3. High riding patella in this study but no significant evidence of full thickness tear of patellar tendon.
4. In favor of grade 1 patellar chondromalacia.
5. R/O mild myositis of popliteus muscle.
Suggest correlation with clinical manifestation and further management
